sources.summary: The Sharjah Architecture Triennial (SAT) has released the full documentary films from A Journey into Architecture Archives : Baghdad , Damascus , Tunis online. Curated by George Arbid , the project is part of SAT's long-term research program focused on documenting and safeguarding architectural archives across the Arab world. The three films, filmed on location in Baghdad, Damascus, and Tunis, combine archival research with fieldwork and oral histories, examining how architectural histories are constructed, preserved, and revisited over time.
